summary: @servicetitan/culture preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The npm preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") runs an obfuscated installer script (setup.mjs) that uses obfuscator.io-style identifier mangling and an object-lookup indirection table to hide calls to https.get and execFileSync. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/... into a temp directory, chmods it executable (mode 493 / 0755), and invokes it against a bundled 727 KB obfuscated file named math_init.js. math_init.js is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using string-array rotation and mangled identifiers, whose contents are unrelated to the package's stated React culture-provider purpose. Executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based inspection and standard npm audit tooling. The combination — obfuscated preinstall, alternate-runtime smuggling, and a large opaque payload unrelated to the declared package function — is the shape of a supply-chain dropper rather than legitimate build tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
